answer.answer: Real defect: denominator is `len(p)+1` instead of `len(p)`, so it returns `sum/len+1` not arithmetic mean. Empty case is correct (`None`). Minimal fix: `return sum(p)/len(p) if p else None`. Effect is masked when sum is 0 (c2,c3).
